agents.summary: The format mechanic is not a fight scene; it is contradiction proof through care objects moving while faces remain stubborn.
Every slide has one visible action: distance, refusal, plate nudge, water reminder, second glass, two-glass payoff.
Aachu carries visible gussa and hidden care; Zuv answers with reciprocal care, not a speech.
Use upper-middle handwritten text on clean ivory paper. Keep faces and hands lower/middle-lower for both native aspects.
Prompts must emphasize domestic care receipts, exact text, identity references, and premium watercolor-and-ink style.
Selected Care Receipts On The Low Table. Blocks generic argument, apology, saintly husband, or quote-card execution.

cross_debate: Do not show a major fight or tears.
Keep the comedy in the contradiction: not talking, still instructing.
selected_visual_system: Care Receipts On The Low Table
why_it_wins: It produces a clean visual receipt trail: gussa is in posture, care is in object movement.
rejected_visual_patterns: one person standing over the other
slide_visual_blueprint: Slide 1: distance and quiet care objects.
